Step 1: ACCEL_CONFIG (0x1C) bits 4:3 are AFS_SEL, the accelerometer full-scale select; GYRO_CONFIG (0x1B) bits 4:3 are FS_SEL.
Step 2: AFS_SEL codes 0-3 select ±2, ±4, ±8, ±16 g; FS_SEL codes 0-3 select ±250, ±500, ±1000, ±2000 °/s.
Step 3: the datasheet prints the sensitivities: 16384, 8192, 4096, 2048 LSB/g and 131.1, 65.5, 32.8, 16.4 LSB/(°/s). Check: 32768 / 2 = 16384 and 32768 / 250 = 131.07, consistent with a 16-bit signed output.
Step 4: each doubling of the range halves the sensitivity - consistent.

engineering_brief:
## What it is
The DX-IMU6 is a 6-axis IMU (3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope, 16-bit) on I2C at 0x68 (0x69 with AD0 high), with a data-ready interrupt and an on-chip temperature sensor.

## Key limits
| Parameter | Min | Typ | Max | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supply voltage VDD | 2.375 | 3.3 | 3.46 | V |
| VDD absolute maximum | -0.3 | | 4.0 | V |
| I/O supply VDDIO | 1.71 | 1.8 | 3.46 | V |
| Supply current (normal) | | 3.9 | | mA |
| Operating temperature | -40 | | 85 | °C |
| I2C clock | | | 400 | kHz |

## Wiring checklist
- [ ] VDD 3.3 V, never above 4.0 V (absolute maximum)
- [ ] VDDIO not higher than VDD
- [ ] 100 nF decoupling at VDD and VDDIO, 100 nF from REGOUT to GND
- [ ] SDA/SCL pull-ups to VDDIO: 2.2 kΩ for 400 kHz
- [ ] AD0 tied low (address 0x68) or high (0x69), never floating

## Driver start-up sequence
1. Read WHO_AM_I (0x75): must be 0x6C.
2. Write PWR_MGMT_1 (0x6B) = 0x00 to leave sleep (reset value 0x40 = SLEEP set).
3. Write SMPLRT_DIV (0x19) = 9 for 100 Hz, CONFIG (0x1A) DLPF_CFG for the filter.
4. Write ACCEL_CONFIG (0x1C) AFS_SEL and GYRO_CONFIG (0x1B) FS_SEL; divide raw values by 16384 LSB/g and 131.1 LSB/(°/s) at the smallest ranges.
5. Enable DATA_RDY_EN in INT_ENABLE (0x38); read 14 bytes from 0x3B in one burst.

## Gotchas
- The part starts in sleep mode: nothing changes until SLEEP is cleared.
- Read the high byte first; the low byte is latched then.
- INT_STATUS clears on read: read it once per interrupt.
- Mechanical shock above 10000 g can damage it: do not drop the board.

ask_datasheet.What is the I2C address: The I2C address is 0x68, or 0x69 when the AD0 pin is high [p. 1]. Tie AD0 to a defined level [p. 2].
ask_datasheet.What pull-up resistors: Use pull-ups to VDDIO: 4.7 kΩ for 100 kHz or 2.2 kΩ for 400 kHz [p. 2]. The maximum SCL clock is 400 kHz [p. 4].
ask_datasheet.How do I convert the temperature: Temperature in °C = TEMP_OUT / 340 + 36.53, where TEMP_OUT is the signed 16-bit value from TEMP_OUT_H and TEMP_OUT_L [p. 6].
